    Gallery

    The work, by environment

    Filter by facility type. Every image here is a representative photo of the kind of floor each environment calls for.

    Cleanroom & Pharma

    Seamless, non-porous surfaces that wipe down fast and leave nowhere for contamination to hide.

    Cleanroom

    Food Processing

    Washdown-ready floors sloped to drains, built to take thermal shock, moisture, and daily sanitation.

    Food Processing

    Stadium & Retail

    High-traffic concourse floors that hold their shine through event after event — and clean up between them.

    Stadium & Retail

    Garage & Service Bays

    Flake epoxy that shrugs off hot tires, oil, and road salt while making the whole bay look finished.

    Garage

    Warehouse & Distribution

    Forklift-grade surfaces with the flatness, markings, and abrasion resistance a working aisle needs.

    Warehouse

    Loading & Logistics

    Dock-to-rack floors with safety striping that stays visible under constant pallet and truck traffic.

    Warehouse

    Floor systems

    Epoxy & concrete, specified on site

    The right system depends on your slab, your traffic, and what hits the floor every day. That's decided at the site visit — not from a price list.

    Epoxy Flooring

    Resinous epoxy systems for industrial and commercial slabs — seamless finishes chosen for chemical exposure, washdowns, forklift traffic, and the look the space needs after the crew leaves.

    Concrete Flooring

    Concrete flooring for facilities that want the slab itself to be the finish — hard-wearing, low-maintenance surfaces for warehouses, retail, and production space.

    01Site visit

    We walk the floor, check the slab's condition and moisture, and measure the space.

    02Specification

    You get a system matched to your traffic, chemicals, and downtime window.

    03Preparation

    The slab is ground and repaired so the new system bonds the way it should.

    04Install & cure

    Coats go down in sequence and cure before the floor goes back to work.
